description: The chart illustrates the performance of three models, Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale, on the QA-1 task, comparing their accuracy in terms of correct, partially correct, and incorrect responses. The vertical axis lists the model names, while the horizontal axis represents the proportion of responses, ranging from 0 to 1 with an interval of 0.04 between tick labels, although the labels are not explicitly shown. Each model's performance is represented by a stacked bar, divided into three segments: dark blue for "Correct", blue for "Partially Correct", and light blue for an unlabeled category, presumably "Incorrect". The Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B model has a "Correct" proportion of 0.88, "Partially Correct" of 0.08, and "Incorrect" of 0.04. In contrast, both EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale have a "Correct" proportion of 0.96, "Partially Correct" of 0, and "Incorrect" of 0.04. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative performance of the three models on the QA-1 task.
